author: Knuronick
quote: unstable, boring, bugged is just the start of the problems with it. Worst Mc's ever, worst storyline ever, to much "detail" but it's blatantly obvious how little polished this slop had. Ultra-Anti consumer politics, A f*ing subscription to ACCESS single player content, they say they want "realism" but then theres a Red hulk wannabe and a giant crab out of nowhere, I could forgive most of it, if it wasn't so obvious how much of an industry plant this Slop is. Worst game of all time.
